'''''Coronet Skyscraper Blueprint''''' was a poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It depicted a blueprint of a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] destined to be built in the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]]. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] lettering at the top of the poster read "Coronet Skyscraper".<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Coronet Skyscraper Blueprint'' was a poster that appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']],<ref name="SWG" /> which was released on [[June 26]], [[2003]]<ref name="Start">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/videogames/news/news20030617.html|text=''Galaxies'' to Release June 26}}</ref> and shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It could be used in the player's home as a decoration, and was made by collecting all the parts for the "viewscreen printer" item which can be looted from various enemies in the game. When all were collected and combined, it produced one of three random paintings, the others being ''[[Cargo Port Blueprint]]'' and [[Freedom (painting)|''Freedom'']]. With the introduction of the ''New Game Enhancements'' in [[2005]], several items required for the viewscreen printer were no longer obtainable, making these paintings valuable collector's items within the game.<ref name="SWG" />
